description: ⚠ DESTRUCTIVE: remove a heading row plus its body (down to the next heading of equal-or-higher level); ONLY use when the user explicitly asks to drop a section. Anything inside that section is gone - there is no per-call undo. If you're unsure which heading they meant, call `naumu_note_read` first to see the current structure. Returns 404 if `headingText` does not exactly match any live heading.

headingText.description: Exact text of the heading whose section will be deleted

name: naumu_note_delete_section
title: Delete Section
